blocks.text: Regal Entertainment Inc. has warned the public that its official X (formerly Twitter) account has been compromised and is currently under unauthorized access. In a Facebook statement on Monday, Sept. 26, the film production and distribution company said any activities coming from the account, @Regalfilms, during this period are not authorized by or affiliated with Regal Entertainment Inc. “We strongly urge everyone to disregard any content, messages, or links posted through the compromised account and refrain from providing any personal or account information,” read the statement.
